content:
The City of Laredo unveiled a new downtown landmark on Wednesday, Nov. 18, holding a ribbon-cutting ceremony for the Laredo Farmworkers Walkway at 1000 Zaragoza St.

Mayor Dr. Victor D. Treviño joined members of the Laredo Farmworkers Alliance for the unveiling in historic downtown Laredo.

The walkway features two steel archways and a commemorative bronze plaque, serving as a lasting tribute to the hard work, dedication and contributions of farmworkers.

The walkway was renamed earlier this year from the Cesar Chavez Walkway to the Laredo Farmworkers Walkway, shifting the focus to recognizing local farmworker history and the generations of workers who left the region to harvest crops across the United States.

The City invites the community to visit the walkway at 1000 Zaragoza St. in historic downtown Laredo.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 18, 2026.
